title: My Pride and Joy
text: An Owala is truly the best water bottle I’ve had, and I’ve tried other brands before, like Hydro Flask, Stanley, and Ello. All of which don't stand a chance against Owala. I’m someone who struggles to drink water. It just never seems appetizing to me; however, with the Owala having a straw, it's just so easy to, while, still lying down, sip from it. I will say it doesn't keep your ice from melting, but it does keep the water cold, almost like cold fridge water all day. It takes about 3 refills of the bottle before there's no more cold water from all the ice melting. It’s also easy to clean; all the parts come off, which makes it super helpful in making sure everything is clean. I love how it has a drinking part and a sipping part; it makes drinking water easier and more accessible to people. I am also very clumsy, and it took me about two years for my first Owala to break, and I used to drop it every day. I didn’t really care if it fell because any good water bottle will still hold up, and the way I did drop it was because it landed on the top, breaking the screw inside; however, that was user error that does not happen every single time you drop it. It never leaks like the Ello water bottle, which also had issues after a few months of having it. I love how it also covers the drinking compartments, so no germs are touching them, something that the Hydro Flask and Stanley don't have. I am not trying to bash other brands; I am simply just trying to show the parts that, to me, make an Owala special. I do understand that an Owala is costly; however, it's so worth it. The rubber part does grow mold over time; however, they do sell that part separately so you can replace it, as well as their straws, for cheap, too. It starts at about 1.99, but counting tax/shipping, it was 7.99. It is a little expensive for the replacements, but it's also a replacement, so a win is a win. In conclusion, if you are someone who is looking for a sustainable, long-term great water bottle and who is clumsy, then this is the one, and it can't be topped.
